writing.overall_comment: A well-scoped, boundary-aware architect subagent with clear role and output contracts, slightly padded by redundant restatements of skills and process.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: Description clearly signals architecture design, tech selection, and ADR authoring so a main agent can route confidently, though it is a bit generic without concrete trigger examples.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: Role, domain expertise, workflow, design principles, and a strong output contract (ADR/design doc with mandatory trade-offs) are all explicit.

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: A dedicated 边界与交接 section clearly forbids implementation and unilateral system changes and specifies hand-back conditions to the main agent.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: The prompt is largely purposeful but the 集成技能 block restates the frontmatter skills and 响应模式 partly duplicates the workflow, adding avoidable tokens.

suggestions: Remove the 集成技能 block or reduce it to a one-line pointer to the frontmatter skills, since it restates the same information and adds avoidable tokens.
In the 响应模式 section, delete or merge the parts that duplicate the workflow so the response pattern does not repeat the same instructions.
